name: Social sentiment positive regime + momentum — mood-confirmed continuation (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why social sentiment leads continuation): LunarCrush social sentiment is a broad crowd-mood proxy; a constructive reading reflects sustained positive engagement that keeps incremental buyers flowing before the mood is fully priced. Distinct from the social-sentiment-divergence CONTRARIAN (which fades a mood/price mismatch), this is the CONTINUATION regime: positive mood AND positive ret_Nd, i.e. the mood is confirming, not contradicting, price. Exit when sentiment rolls back below neutral (the mood regime broke). DISCONFIRMER 1: if plain momentum without the sentiment gate matches the deflated Sharpe, sentiment adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 2 (scale/level trap): LunarCrush sentiment's scale can drift across regimes — if the fitted floor lands where it is always-true, the filter is inert and the Gate must kill it; the edge must come from actually excluding negative-mood bars. tier1, low-confidence until validated OOS.
catalyst: social_sentiment is above a positive threshold (crowd mood constructive) while price momentum is positive.
